gloss: to hone one's skills; to improve one's abilities; to polish one's craft

definitions.gloss: to hone one's skills; to improve one's abilities; to polish one's craft
definitions.explanation: To work on improving one's skills or abilities through practice and effort. Implies dedicated, ongoing effort to become better at something.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{練習|れんしゅう}して{腕|うで}を{磨|みが}いている。
examples.english: I practice every day to hone my skills.

examples.japanese: {料理|りょうり}の{腕|うで}をもっと{磨|みが}きたい。
examples.english: I want to improve my cooking skills more.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}で{腕|うで}を{磨|みが}いてきたシェフだ。
examples.english: He's a chef who honed his skills overseas.

notes:
IDIOM STRUCTURE:
{腕|うで} (arm; skill) + を + {磨|みが}く (to polish)

{腕|うで} here means skill/ability. {磨|みが}く (to polish) creates the metaphor of polishing or refining a skill like one would polish a gem or blade.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{料理|りょうり}の{腕|うで}を{磨|みが}く - to improve cooking skills
・{語学|ごがく}の{腕|うで}を{磨|みが}く - to improve language skills
・{技術|ぎじゅつ}の{腕|うで}を{磨|みが}く - to hone technical skills
・{日々|ひび}{腕|うで}を{磨|みが}く - to polish skills day by day

NUANCE:
Implies:
- Deliberate effort to improve
- Ongoing process, not one-time action
- Recognition that one can always get better
- Dedication and commitment to improvement

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{技|わざ}を{磨|みが}く - to polish one's technique
・{実力|じつりょく}を{付|つ}ける - to build up ability
・{スキルアップ|すきるあっぷ}する - to skill up (modern)
・{研鑽|けんさん}を{積|つ}む - to accumulate training (formal)

RELATED EXPRESSION:
{腕|うで}を{振|ふ}るう - to show one's skill (complementary - first you polish, then you show)
